review:
Le Digger sends Smokey treasure-hunting through layered ground. On a win, every symbol of the winning type is removed along with one layer behind it. Dynamite thrown by Smokey removes more symbols and layers, and Wild Dynamite clears a 3×3 area.

Once the third layer is reached, Golden Reveals show Coins, Green and Gold Clovers and Collectors: Clovers boost coins and Collectors gather them. Three bonus games build on this, the first starting with three FS symbols and offering a gamble or 10 free spins with a Dynamite Collector. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game.
